notes.subject: מעשרתיכם
notes.rationale: Tithing — the tenth part of all produce, a counted portion.

notes.subject: תרומת ידכם
notes.rationale: Hebrew 'contribution of your hand' rendered 'ol presen bilong han bilong yupela', keeping the hand imagery.

translation: Na yupela i ken bringim ol i go long en: ol sakrifais bilong yupela i go antap long paia, na ol sakrifais bilong yupela, na ⟨את⟩ ten bilong olgeta samting bilong yupela, na ⟨את⟩ ol presen bilong han bilong yupela, na ol promis bilong yupela, na ol samting yupela givim long laik bilong yupela yet, na ol pikinini namba wan bilong ol bulmakau bilong yupela, na bilong ol sipsip na meme bilong yupela.
